data_fields.name: respawn_tile_pattern
data_fields.donor_constant: whole board: offsets from -BOARDCOL..BOARDCOL-1 by -BOARDROW..BOARDROW-1, origin (0,0)

data_fields.name: no_free_tile_retry
data_fields.donor_constant: none: respawn dropped silently when no tile is free

best_idea: Queue a dead unit's respawn before its death is applied, then on the next boundary pick one free tile from a coverage pattern and spawn it there, never dropping it silently.
decision_why: The free-tile pick inside a zone's coverage fits row 23 respawn, but the end-turn trigger does not fit real time and the server must draw the tile itself (donor uses Math.random and only flags the action).
acceptance: When a zone creature dies with respawn set to N seconds, a creature of that kind appears on a free tile inside the zone coverage within N seconds, chosen on the server; a server test asserts the tile is free and inside coverage, and that a full zone retries rather than dropping the respawn.
